PLAN "12-Week Strength & Mobility for Endometriosis (Start: 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength and mobility with endometriosis considerations"
  GOAL secondary aerobic:
    name "Build aerobic base with low-impact cardio"
  GOAL tertiary metabolic:
    name "Improve metabolic conditioning with HIIT (cycle/row, not on flow or flare days)"
  GOAL quaternary power:
    name "Develop lower body power with plyometrics (not on flow or flare days)"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    summary "3x strength, 2x aerobic base, 1x HIIT (cycle), progressive volume, no plyometrics yet. HIIT only if not on flow/flare days."
  PHASE "Progression" (4 weeks):
    summary "4x strength, 2x aerobic base (longer), 1x HIIT (cycle/row), 1x plyometric (not on flow/flare days). Increased intensity and volume."
  PHASE "Consolidation & Resilience" (4 weeks):
    summary "3x strength, 2x aerobic base, 1x HIIT (cycle), 1x plyometric (not on flow/flare days). Taper intensity, maintain aerobic and power, reinforce mobility and recovery."

NUTRITION
  STRATEGY anti_inflammatory:
    description "Support recovery and reduce inflammation with an anti-inflammatory eating pattern"
    guidelines:
      - "Emphasize a variety of colorful vegetables and fruits daily (aim for 7+ servings)"
      - "Include fatty fish (salmon, sardine, mackerel) 2-3x/week or supplement with algae-based omega-3 if vegetarian"
      - "Use extra virgin olive oil as primary fat source; include nuts and seeds (walnut, flaxseed, chia, pumpkin seed)"
      - "Choose whole grains (quinoa, brown rice, buckwheat, oats) over refined grains"
      - "Include legumes (lentil, chickpea, bean) several times per week"
      - "Prioritize lean proteins (poultry, fish, tofu, tempeh, eggs)"
      - "Limit processed meats, red meat, and added sugars"
      - "Minimize intake of highly processed foods and fried foods"
      - "Flavor with herbs and spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic, cinnamon, rosemary)"
      - "Stay hydrated: aim for 2+ liters water daily"
      - "Limit alcohol and caffeine, especially during flare or flow days"
      - "Consider probiotic-rich foods (yogurt, kefir, sauerkraut, kimchi) for gut health"
    sample_day:
      breakfast: "Oats with blueberries, chia seeds, walnuts, and cinnamon"
      snack: "Carrot sticks and hummus"
      lunch: "Quinoa salad with mixed greens, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olive oil, and lemon"
      snack: "Apple and pumpkin seeds"
      dinner: "Grilled salmon, steamed broccoli, and brown rice"
      optional: "Turmeric-ginger herbal tea in the evening"
    notes:
      - "Adjust fiber intake if experiencing GI symptoms"
      - "During flare or flow days, focus on easy-to-digest foods and hydration"
      - "Consult with a registered dietitian for personalized support if needed"
